title: FaultDx FHKB Canonical Case Ingestion Contract
description: Defines the canonical, governed historical-case object accepted by FHKB. Cases remain candidate references and cannot be promoted in place.

identity_rules.case_id: FHC_ plus SHA-256 of the canonical JSON tuple [fhkb_case_identity_v1, source_id, source_version, sorted unique source_record_ids].
identity_rules.collision_behavior: Reject duplicate case_id when canonical serialized record content differs. Byte-equivalent duplicates may be collapsed deterministically.
identity_rules.rebuild_behavior: Unchanged governed source identity produces the same case_id across deterministic rebuilds.

missingness_rules.nullable_scalar: Use explicit null when the source does not provide a scalar value.
missingness_rules.repeatable_text: Use an empty array when the source provides no cause, action, or observed phenomenon text.
missingness_rules.no_chain_completion: Do not infer a missing phenomenon, cause, action, time, equipment scope, or evidence value.
missingness_rules.minimum_retrieval_text: At least one observed or normalized phenomenon, candidate cause, or candidate action is required.

legacy_adapter.name: fhkb_legacy_adapter_v1

field_mapping.rag_candidate_id: discarded after validating the legacy input envelope; it is not emitted by FHKB

legacy_adapter.source_record_resolution: Use explicit canonical source_record_id when present. For the legacy SourceRef shape, derive FHS_ plus SHA-256 of its closed canonical fields and retain every legacy field in the canonical source reference.
legacy_adapter.normalization: Scalar or list legacy text becomes a trimmed, order-preserving, de-duplicated string array. Empty strings become missing values, never inferred text.
legacy_adapter.unsafe_behavior: Reject blocked fields, promotion claims, wrong route markers, ambiguous provenance, unsupported evidence shapes, and conflicting identity collisions.

breaking_changes: The legacy producer identifier is not emitted; canonical identity is case_id.
Legacy FP/RC/PA fields move into typed canonical case content.
Release, source version, lineage, masking, serving safety, and record-level source refs are mandatory.
Unknown canonical record fields are rejected.
migration: Keep route_c_source_boundary_v1 active until this pair is frozen and runtime adoption is approved.
Run the offline legacy adapter against approved serving-safe packages.
Validate canonical output and migrate consumer lookup behavior to case_id.
Bind a consumer only after affected-consumer review.
compatibility.rollback: Continue using the named Route C source-boundary projection. The offline adapter does not mutate the source package or runtime binding.
